scalars.scalar_value: Advanced degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.

items.item_text: Advanced degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
10 - 15 years of related experience.
Previous supervisory/managerial experience.
Experience at a leadership level with responsibility for financial planning and analysis.
Experience within a large, decentralized public higher education system.
Leads other senior managers to establish strategic plans and objectives. (25% time)
Represents the Budget Office in organization-wide and systemwide meetings and discussions; plans, designs, and implements organization-wide budget processes. (20% time)

Executive Financial Reporting, Communications, and Decision Support: Lead development of executive-level financial reports, dashboards, presentations, briefing materials and institutional analyses. Ensure timely, accurate and decision-oriented financial reporting for executive leadership, governance bodies and campus stakeholders. Translates complex financial concepts into clear, concise and actionable communication materials for diverse audiences. Advance institutional financial literacy and analytic capabilities among campus leadership groups and support the Chief Financial and Administrative Officers (CFAOs). (15% time)

Frequently interacts with executives and/or major customers. Interactions often involve controversial situations, customer negotiations, or influencing and persuading other senior level managers. (10% time)

Directs and controls the activities of a broad functional area through several unit managers within the organization having overall responsibility for planning, budgeting, implementing and maintaining costs, methods, and employees. (10% time)
Provides direction and expertise to financial analysis department, projects and work assignments. (10% time)
Makes final decisions on administrative or operational matters and ensures effective achievement of operation's objectives. (5% time)
Directs, controls and has overall accountability for internal controls to protect University resources. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Constantly
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Sit: Frequently
Stand: Frequently
Walk: Frequently
Expert and broad knowledge of full range of financial policies, practices and systems. Budgeting and reporting techniques; fund accounting; human resource planning; accounting and bookkeeping.
Expert ability to effectively communicate complex findings and recommendations verbally and in writing.
Expert interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively across the organization at all levels; ability to interact with a diverse population.
Client services oriented; good listening, critical thinking and analytical skills.
Ability to multi-task.
Expertise in internal control practices. Experience in implementing controls that strengthen the control environment throughout the organization.
Expert negotiation skills.

Demonstrated experience developing, leading, and monitoring complex operating budgets for a large organization, preferably in higher education, government, healthcare, or another multifaceted public-sector environment.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives, managing competing priorities, and implementing process improvements in a complex organizational environment.

Experience with multi-fund budgeting (state appropriations, tuition, auxiliaries, grants, capital projects, etc.) and with enterprise financial systems, data analytics, and business intelligence tools.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships across organizational units.
Expert skills in strategy development, systems planning, and change management, and ability to work effectively and sometimes persuasively with all levels within the organization.
Experience conducting financial analysis, forecasting, modeling, and scenario planning to support executive decision-making and strategic resource allocation.
Advanced knowledge of budget development processes, financial management principles, internal controls, and fiscal accountability practices.
Experience presenting financial information and recommendations to executive leadership, governing boards, senior administrators, or other key stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to interpret financial data and translate complex analyses into clear, actionable information for diverse audiences.
Expert modeling and analytical skills.
Expert knowledge of complex financial policies, practices and systems; budgeting and reporting techniques; fund accounting; human resource planning; accounting and bookkeeping.
